name: FreeToken
description: Serves large Mixture-of-Experts models such as DeepSeek-V4-Flash and GLM-5.2 on consumer NVIDIA GPUs, sharing work across GPU and CPU behind OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs.

skills.name: Compatible API Server
skills.description: Starts a local server with ft serve that exposes OpenAI /v1 endpoints, the Anthropic Messages API and the Responses API for a chosen model.

skills.name: Coding Agent Launcher
skills.description: Discovers the served model with ft launch, writes the coding agent's provider config, installs its CLI if missing and launches it.

skills.name: MoE Expert Offload
skills.description: Runs MoE layers with bandwidth-adaptive CPU-GPU co-execution and LRU expert caching, reallocating VRAM between experts and KV at runtime.
